title: Act: Create the runner package with lock, worktree and timeout
summary: Add runner.go with interfaces, Config, New and Run
description: Create backend/worker/internal/runner/runner.go defining Agent, Worktrees, Publisher, Config, Runner, New and Run that locks, saves RUNNING, creates the worktree, runs the agent once under the timeout and saves the final status.
acceptance_criteria: Run returns a lock.ErrLocked-wrapping error when the lock is held

steps.symbol: new: interfaces Agent, Worktrees, Publisher and type Config
steps.action: Create package runner importing context, errors, fmt, path/filepath, time, github.com/worldseed/storyforge/worker/internal/lock and .../internal/store. Declare Agent, Worktrees, Publisher interfaces and Config struct.
steps.expected: Package compiles with the four declarations

steps.action: Declare Runner holding cfg Config, st *store.Store, agent Agent, trees Worktrees, pub Publisher, now func() time.Time, and New(cfg, st, agent, trees, pub, now) *Runner assigning each field.
steps.code: func New(cfg Config, st *store.Store, a Agent, t Worktrees, p Publisher, now func() time.Time) *Runner

steps.action: Implement Run(ctx, id, roundID string) (store.Execution, error): (1) l, err := lock.Acquire(cfg.LockPath); on err return store.Execution{}, fmt.Errorf("runner: %w", err); defer l.Release(). (2) build e := store.Execution{ID:id, RoundID:roundID, Status:store.StatusRunning, CreatedAt:r.now(), UpdatedAt:r.now()} and st.Save(e), returning the error. (3) dir := filepath.Join(cfg.WorkRoot, id); call trees.Create(ctx, dir), on error fail. (4) tctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, cfg.Timeout); defer cancel(). (5) e.Attempt = 1; _, err = agent.Run(tctx, dir). (6) on err set e.Status=StatusFailed, e.Error=err.Error(), UpdatedAt, Save, call trees.Remove(ctx, dir), return e, err. (7) on success set e.Status=StatusCompleted, Save, trees.Remove(ctx, dir), return e, nil.
steps.expected: Held lock returns lock.ErrLocked; timeout yields FAILED with DeadlineExceeded
